There is a boat on the shore that was not there yesterday. Did the sea bring it, or did you?
The sea brings what a heart keeps asking for. You have stood on this cliff every evening for a year, looking west.
Only to see if the land is still there. My father's hall. The hounds. Three hundred years is a long time not to look.
Then go and look. Take Embarr, and stay in the saddle. Whatever they say to you, whatever you see, do not let your feet touch that ground.
One evening. I will count the waterfalls on the way back, and you will hear the number before dark.
